title: This Antarctic Fish Has No Red Blood and a See-Through Body

scenes.text: There's a fish with no red blood.
Antarctic icefish have no hemoglobin, the protein that makes blood red.
Their blood runs translucent, their gills are creamy white, and their bodies are see through.
They are the only vertebrates on Earth without red blood.
They survive because the freezing Southern Ocean holds a huge amount of oxygen.
A bigger heart, wider vessels and ice cold water. No red needed.
